summary: Two changes authored, both openspec-validate --strict clean: gap-02-jwks-token-verifier (capability jwt-hardening, ADDED) and gap-03-a2a-tenant-partitioning (capability tenant-isolation, new). Operator resolved D-2: tenant_id is distinct from sub, so GAP-03 declares its own capability rather than extending multi-tenant-isolation, whose scenarios are user-scoped. An overlap scan of ~190 active changes surfaced harden-jwt-defaults (0/3, same capability, overlapping claim-validation requirement - precedence rule written into the contract) and fix-sidecar-loopback-auth (5/6, compatible, guarded by a stop condition). GAP-05 held: add-skill-system-submodule (13/16) already chose in-memory-only builtin registration deliberately, which is the actual cause of the gap, so specifying it now would conflict with a nearly-finished change.
heldItems: GAP-05 pending operator decision on builtin persistence
